payload.title: Add lint rules: Touches shape, task-block citations, UI-task priority
payload.body:
Port three opt-in lint rules into packages/lint: (1) Touches field is a comma list of repo-relative globs; (2) citations in a task block point at a file or URL that exists; (3) a UI task is not filed below P2. Sources: https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/check-touches-field.mjs, https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/check-task-block-citations.mjs, https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/check-ui-tasks-priority.mjs (credit only). Each rule is opt-in so existing queues do not break.
- **Hypothesis**: three opt-in rules catch malformed Touches lines and dead citations at lint time instead of at pick time; bad-field task picks drop to 0 in a fixture queue.
- **Measurement**: npm test -w packages/lint
- **Success**: each rule has a failing and a passing fixture; default lint output is unchanged on examples/.
- **Pivot**: if a rule needs more than 100 lines or needs repo knowledge, keep it in the consumer repo.
- **Anchor**: Fagerholm et al. 2014 (continuous experimentation).
